name: Family Council v2 - KB File Processor

parameters.query:
-- One file at a time, and only when nothing else is in flight.
--
-- The Vertex quota is 5 embedding requests per minute (textembedding-gecko,
-- us-central1) and Google will not raise it for this project. Embedding is
-- therefore throttled inside the run by "Embed Batch Loop" - 3 chunks, wait 65s.
-- Two runs overlapping would double that rate and start failing with 429 again,
-- so the NOT EXISTS below acts as a mutex: claim nothing while another file is
-- still being processed.
--
-- The stale window is 3 hours, not 30 minutes, because a large file now
-- legitimately takes hours to embed at this rate.
UPDATE fc_kb_queue SET status = 'processing', updated_at = now()
WHERE file_id IN (
  SELECT file_id FROM fc_kb_queue
  WHERE (status = 'pending'
         OR (status = 'processing' AND updated_at < now() - interval '3 hours'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM fc_kb_queue busy
      WHERE busy.status = 'processing'
        AND busy.updated_at >= now() - interval '3 hours'
    )
  ORDER BY updated_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
RETURNING file_id, file_name, mime_type, parent_folder;
UPDATE fc_kb_queue SET status = 'skipped', updated_at = now() WHERE file_id = $1;

parameters.content:
## KB File Processor

Runs every 15 minutes and claims ONE pending file from fc_kb_queue, then: download from Drive, convert to PDF if needed (ConvertAPI), extract text, delete the file's old chunks, chunk, embed (Vertex text-embedding-005), store in fc_kb_vectors, mark the queue row done.

!! DO NOT raise the rate without checking for 429s !!
This was 3 files every 5 minutes. On 7 Aug a full re-index pushed all 475 files through at once, exhausted the Google Vertex embedding quota, and "Embeddings Google Vertex" began failing with HTTP 429 after ~120s of retries. Failed files stayed in 'processing', were re-claimed after 30 minutes and failed again, pinning the quota for two days.

The damage is not limited to ingestion: the CHAT workflow embeds every user question through the same Vertex API, so a saturated quota takes the chatbot down too - questions hang for 120s and return "Message delivery is being retried". If the chatbot starts timing out, look here first.

To go faster, raise the Vertex embedding quota in Google Cloud rather than the rate here.

### Queue statuses
- done - text extracted and embedded
- skipped - unsupported type (zip, video)
- no_text - NOTHING searchable came out. Either OCR failed or the pages genuinely carry no text. Page images are still stored and viewable; the chatbot just cannot search them. Never re-claimed automatically, so it will not loop.

Until 24 Aug these landed as 'done' with zero chunks, so seven real governance documents looked ingested but were invisible to search. OCR Page Text now uses its error output: failures are written to fc_kb_errors and the file becomes 'no_text'.

Find anything unsearchable with:
  SELECT file_name FROM fc_kb_queue WHERE status = 'no_text';
To retry one, set it back to 'pending'.

The queue is filled by "Family Council v2 - KB Ingestion (Google Drive)" (the crawler). Check progress with: SELECT status, count(*) FROM fc_kb_queue GROUP BY status;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending')::int AS pending,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'processing')::int AS processing_now,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'done')::int AS done,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'skipped')::int AS skipped,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'no_text')::int AS no_text,
  count(*)::int AS total
FROM fc_kb_queue;

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO fc_kb_images (file_id, page, file_name, mime_type, access, image_base64)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6 WHERE COALESCE($6,'') <> ''
ON CONFLICT (file_id, page) DO UPDATE
SET file_name = excluded.file_name, mime_type = excluded.mime_type, access = excluded.access, image_base64 = excluded.image_base64;

// Scanned PDF (no text layer): re-attach the PDF binary so it can be converted to page images
return [{ json: $input.first().json, binary: $('Force PDF Metadata').first().binary }];

parameters.text: You are an OCR engine. Transcribe ALL text visible in the attached scanned document page image, exactly as written. Preserve the reading order. Include headings, names, dates, amounts, table contents, titles/positions, and the printed names in signature blocks. Format tables as plain rows of text. Output ONLY the transcribed text with no commentary, no introduction, and no markdown code fences. If the page contains no readable text, output nothing.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO fc_kb_errors (occurred_at, workflow_name, execution_id, last_node, message, file_name)
VALUES (now(), 'Family Council v2 - KB File Processor', $1, 'OCR Page Text', $2, $3);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ String($execution.id), String((($json.error && ($json.error.message || $json.error.description)) || $json.message || 'OCR failed with no message')).slice(0, 500), $('Current File').first().json.fileName ] }}

nodes.notes: OCR failures used to vanish silently and the file was marked done with no chunks. Now every failure leaves a row in fc_kb_errors.

nodes.name: Mark File No Text
nodes.notes: Stored page images are still kept, so the chatbot can show these files even though it cannot search their contents.

nodes.name: KB Text Splitter
nodes.notes: Exists only to STOP the loader's default 1000/200 splitter. Text arrives pre-chunked at 2500 with 300 overlap from Chunk KB Text / Combine OCR Chunks; 4000 with no overlap lets it through untouched. Do not lower this below 2500 or the pre-chunking is silently undone again.
